observations: Nexus skybridge shows a thin suspended platform, distinct lower floor and twelve real treads across its three access cells. The underside does not fill the passage.
Ruined terraces use stone top and wall textures, earth ramps, grass ground and distinct stair treads. The elevated solid terrace does not invent a walkable floor underneath.
Cyber catwalk uses a grate top, thin metal fascia and visible railings over a separate lower floor.

The level0 view removes elevated decks and their actors while keeping the true remaining floor and the entry ramps/stairs whose minimum height is0. The cut is a visibility filter, not a geometric excavation.
Material detail follows each face, and the full-board source image is not stretched over cliffs.
These six canvases use the shipped renderer module with simple actor markers; actual GameCanvas interactions remain a separate verification responsibility.
limits: Original procedural material study; no claim of official texture or universe architecture fidelity.
No frame-rate claim or final production freeze claim.
